terminal.explain: The vendor provides a card terminal for payments at the truck.

tldr.body: If your customers should order ahead on their phone and choose a pickup time, you need an ordering system, not just a POS. Look for four things: pickup times that follow your kitchen capacity; a weekly schedule for changing locations; low or no fees per order; and no long contract. Card terminals and POS systems cover payment at the truck and complement an ordering system.

faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or at pickup, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS or card terminal takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
